```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr) 
library(tidyr)

genes_of_interest <- c("Krt16", "Krt6a", "Krt14", "Krt10", "Krt1", "Cdh13", "Sox6", "Sema3c", "Sema5a")

# Fetch metadata and expression matrix
meta_data <- alldata.1@meta.data[, c("orig.ident", "timepoint")]
DefaultAssay(alldata.1) = "RNA"
expr_data <- FetchData(alldata.1, vars = genes_of_interest, layer = "data")

# Combine expression + metadata
expr_with_meta <- cbind(meta_data, expr_data)

# Calculate average expression per gene per sample
avg_expr_per_sample <- expr_with_meta %>%
  group_by(orig.ident, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(genes_of_interest), mean), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(genes_of_interest), names_to = "Gene", values_to = "AvgExpression")


# Set factor levels for timepoint (optional but good practice)
avg_expr_per_sample$timepoint <- factor(avg_expr_per_sample$timepoint,
                                        levels = c("UW", "D1PW", "D2PW", "D4PW", "D7PW", "D15PW", "D30PW"))

# Plot
g <- ggplot(avg_expr_per_sample, aes(x = timepoint, y = AvgExpression)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, fill = "grey90", color = "black") +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = timepoint), width = 0.2, size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~Gene, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  stat_compare_means(
    method = "wilcox.test",
    comparisons = list(
      c("UW", "D4PW"), c("UW", "D7PW"), c("UW", "D15PW"), c("UW", "D30PW")
    ),
    label = "p.signif",
    label.y.npc = "top",
    size = 4
  ) +
  labs(title = "Average Gene Expression Per Sample by Timepoint",
       x = "Timepoint",
       y = "Avg. Expression (RNA)",
       color = "Timepoint") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey85")
  )

```


```{r}
# Step 1: Get UW averages for each gene
uw_means <- avg_expr_per_sample %>%
  filter(timepoint == "UW") %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>%
  summarise(UW_Mean = mean(AvgExpression), .groups = "drop")

# Step 2: Join back to original dataframe and calculate difference
avg_expr_delta <- avg_expr_per_sample %>%
  left_join(uw_means, by = "Gene") %>%
  mutate(ExpressionDelta = AvgExpression - UW_Mean)

g <- ggplot(avg_expr_delta, aes(x = timepoint, y = ExpressionDelta)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, fill = "grey90", color = "black") +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = timepoint), width = 0.2, size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~Gene, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  stat_compare_means(
    method = "wilcox.test",
    comparisons = list(
      c("UW", "D4PW"), c("UW", "D7PW"), c("UW", "D15PW"), c("UW", "D30PW")
    ),
    label = "p.signif",
    label.y.npc = "top",
    size = 4
  ) +
  labs(title = "Change in Gene Expression Relative to UW",
       x = "Timepoint",
       y = "Δ Expression (Sample Avg. - UW Mean)",
       color = "Timepoint") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey85")
  )


```

```{r}
genes_of_interest <- c("Krt16", "Krt6a", "Krt14", "Krt10", "Krt1", "Cdh13", "Sox6", "Sema3c", "Sema5a")

# Get metadata (just timepoint and sample)
cell_meta <- alldata.1@meta.data[, c("timepoint", "orig.ident")]
expr_data <- FetchData(alldata.1, vars = genes_of_interest)

# Combine
expr_long <- cbind(cell_meta, expr_data) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(genes_of_interest), names_to = "Gene", values_to = "Expression") %>%
  mutate(timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = c("UW", "D1PW", "D2PW", "D4PW", "D7PW", "D15PW", "D30PW")))


library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)

library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)

g <- ggplot(expr_long, aes(x = timepoint, y = Expression)) +
  geom_violin(
    aes(fill = timepoint),
    color = "black",
    scale = "width",
    trim = TRUE,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "crossbar",
    width = 0.5,
    color = "black",
    fatten = 1.5
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Gene, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  stat_compare_means(
    method = "wilcox.test",
    comparisons = list(
      c("UW", "D4PW"), c("UW", "D7PW"), c("UW", "D15PW"), c("UW", "D30PW")
    ),
    label = "p.signif",
    label.y.npc = "top",
    p.adjust.method = "BH",
    hide.ns = TRUE,
    size = 4,
    fontface = "bold"  # Bold the ** symbols
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Per-Cell Gene Expression by Timepoint",
    x = "Timepoint",
    y = "Expression (log-normalized)"
  ) +
  theme_ggprism_mod(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),  # remove all grid lines
    legend.position = "none"
  )

ggsave(
  filename = "PerCell_GeneExpression_ViolinPlot.pdf",
  plot = g,
  width = 14,
  height = 10
)
```

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
library(scCustomize)

# Set gene of interest
genes_of_interest <- c("SEMA5A")

# Extract metadata and expression data
cell_meta <- alldata.1@meta.data[, c("group_cond", "orig.ident")]
expr_data <- FetchData(alldata.1, vars = genes_of_interest)

# Combine and reshape
expr_long <- cbind(cell_meta, expr_data) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(genes_of_interest), names_to = "Gene", values_to = "Expression") %>%
  mutate(group_cond = factor(group_cond, levels = c("Unwounded", "D1PW", "D7PW", "D30PW", "UWO_CTRL","NH_DFU", "H_DFU", "Diab_CTRL")))

# Define comparisons of interest
comparisons_list <- list(
  c("Unwounded", "D1PW"),
  c("Unwounded", "D7PW"),
  c("Unwounded", "D30PW"),
  c("UWO_CTRL", "NH_DFU"),
  c("UWO_CTRL", "H_DFU"),
  c("UWO_CTRL", "Diab_CTRL")
)

# Make violin plot
g <- ggplot(expr_long, aes(x = group_cond, y = Expression)) +
  geom_violin(
    aes(fill = group_cond),
    color = "black",
    scale = "width",
    trim = TRUE,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "crossbar",
    width = 0.5,
    color = "black",
    fatten = 1.5
  ) +
  stat_compare_means(
    method = "wilcox.test",
    comparisons = comparisons_list,
    label = "p.signif",
    label.y.npc = "top",
    p.adjust.method = "BH",
    hide.ns = TRUE,
    size = 4,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Gene, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "SEMA5A Expression Across Conditions",
    x = "Condition",
    y = "Average Expression"
  ) +
  theme_ggprism_mod(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 0.8,vjust = 0.8, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

# Save to file
ggsave(
  filename = "SEMA5A_ViolinPlot_ByGroupCond.png",
  plot = g,
  width = 6,
  height = 5
)

```

```{r}
# Define comparisons of interest
comparisons_list <- list(
  c("Unwounded", "D1PW"),
  c("Unwounded", "D7PW"),
  c("Unwounded", "D30PW"),
  c("UWO_CTRL", "NH_DFU"),
  c("UWO_CTRL", "H_DFU"),
  c("UWO_CTRL", "Diab_CTRL")
)

# Generate the plot
g <- ggplot(expr_long, aes(x = group_cond, y = Expression)) +
  geom_violin(
    aes(fill = group_cond),
    color = "black",
    scale = "width",
    trim = T,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +

    fun = mean,
    geom = "crossbar",

    title = "Expression Across Conditions",

    y = "Average Expression"
  ) +

    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),

    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

# Save the plot
ggsave(
  filename = "SEMAVEGF_Genes_ViolinPlot_ByGroupCond.png",

  width = 7,

)
```

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(future)
options(future.globals.maxSize = 30 * 1024^3)
  # or "multicore" on Unix systems

# Remove residuals and scale.data from SCT assay if they exist
alldata.1@assays$SCT@misc$residuals <- NULL
alldata.2@assays$SCT@misc$residuals <- NULL
alldata.1@assays$SCT@scale.data <- matrix()
alldata.2@assays$SCT@scale.data <- matrix()

# Merge the datasets
combined <- merge(alldata.1, y = alldata.2, add.cell.ids = c("DFU", "Wound"))

# Join layers so SCTransform can be run per layer (orig.ident)
combined <- JoinLayers(combined)

# Split the RNA assay by layer (e.g., dataset of origin)
combined[["RNA"]] <- split(combined[["RNA"]], f = combined$orig.ident)

# Run SCTransform across layers
combined <- SCTransform(combined, verbose = TRUE)

# Optional: PCA and clustering if you're ready to proceed
combined <- combined %>%
  RunPCA(verbose = FALSE)

pcs <- npcs(combined)

combined <- combined %>%
  FindNeighbors(reduction = "pca", dims = 1:pcs) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 1.5, cluster.name = "pca_clusters") %>%
  RunUMAP(reduction = "pca", dims = 1:pcs, reduction.name = "umap.pca")

# Save result
saveRDS(combined, "HumanLiuandDiabeticFootUlcer_KeratincoytesCells_SCT_JoinedLayers.rds")
```

```{r}
library(Seurat)

library(forcats)

combined@meta.data <- combined@meta.data %>%
  mutate(
    cond_dfu_abbrev = recode(
      cond_dfu_abbrev,
      "Unwounded"       = "Unwounded",
      "D1PW"            = "D1PW",
      "D7PW"            = "D7PW",
      "D30PW"           = "D30PW",
      "Healthy_Control" = "UWO_CTRL",
      "NonHealing_DFU"  = "NH_DFU",
      "Healing_DFU"     = "H_DFU",
      "Diabetic_NoDFU"  = "Diab_CTRL"
    ),
    cond_dfu_abbrev = factor(
      cond_dfu_abbrev,
      levels = c("UWO_CTRL", "Diab_CTRL", "H_DFU", "NH_DFU","Unwounded", "D1PW", "D7PW", "D30PW")
    )
  )


# Genes of interest
genes_of_interest <- c("SEMA3C","SOX6")

# Extract metadata and expression
cell_meta <- combined@meta.data[, c("cond_dfu_abbrev", "orig.ident")]
expr_data <- FetchData(combined, vars = genes_of_interest)

# Combine and reshape
expr_long <- cbind(cell_meta, expr_data) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(genes_of_interest),
    names_to = "Gene",
    values_to = "Expression"
  ) %>%
  mutate(group_cond = factor(cond_dfu_abbrev, levels = c(
    "Unwounded", "D1PW", "D7PW", "D30PW", "UWO_CTRL", "NH_DFU", "H_DFU", "Diab_CTRL"
  )))

# Define comparisons of interest
comparisons_list <- list(
  c("Unwounded", "D1PW"),
  c("Unwounded", "D7PW"),
  c("Unwounded", "D30PW"),
  c("UWO_CTRL", "NH_DFU"),
  c("UWO_CTRL", "H_DFU"),
  c("UWO_CTRL", "Diab_CTRL")
)


g <- ggplot(expr_long, aes(x = group_cond, y = Expression)) +
  geom_violin(
    aes(fill = group_cond),
    color = "black",
    scale = "width",
    trim = TRUE,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "crossbar",
    width = 0.5,
    color = "black",
    fatten = 1.5
  ) +
  stat_compare_means(
    method = "wilcox.test",
    comparisons = comparisons_list,
    label = "p.signif",
    label.y.npc = "top",
    p.adjust.method = "BH",
    hide.ns = TRUE,
    size = 4,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Gene, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +  # << Changed from ncol = 1 to 2
  labs(
    title = "Expression Across Conditions",
    x = "Condition",
    y = "Average Expression"
  ) +
  theme_ggprism_mod(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 0.8, vjust = 0.8, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

# Save the plot
```
